baseline.reason: Confirmed Firebase foundation plus corrected Leaflet/header layering and extension contract.

change_policy.rule_1: Do not rebuild the whole app to fix one module.
change_policy.rule_2: Freeze working modules and replace only the module under change.
change_policy.rule_3: Every release declares baseline, changed modules, unchanged modules, and regression checks.
change_policy.rule_4: Do not remove or rename an existing data path without a migration plan.
change_policy.rule_5: QUEST integration happens only after the standalone foundation is stable.

uiShell.responsibility: Sticky header, view stacking and Leaflet layout boundary
uiShell.fix: Header isolated above Leaflet panes/controls; map kept in low stacking context.

extensionContract.responsibility: Stable insertion points for future information/features without rebuilding core.

eventSettingsEditor.responsibility: Owner event-name / route-mode / start / end form editing
eventSettingsEditor.fix: Realtime render no longer overwrites unsaved administrator input.

foundation_requirements: Location sharing, chat, support and monitoring work without a course.
LIVE ephemeral data stays separate from records/results.
Future QUEST integration uses an adapter; QUEST-specific logic does not enter the foundation core.

release_2_3.purpose: Keep the successful v2.2 Firebase connection while restoring reload/session continuity without using QUEST-shared localStorage.

rules: Extensions may add UI/data but must not rename existing core paths.
Each extension declares its own module key and version.
Only the changed module and integration points are modified in a release.
New Firebase write paths require an explicit Security Rules change before activation.

regression_checks: LIVE map remains below sticky header
release_2_4.purpose: Fix Leaflet/header overlap and make future additions attach to stable extension points instead of rebuilding the foundation.

regression_checks: LIVE map remains below sticky header
Typing event name is not erased by realtime render
Route mode/start/end drafts are also preserved until save
Saved event settings still propagate through Firebase
release_2_5.purpose: Make event settings safely editable while preserving the modular v2.4 foundation.
